svg.title: Six hyperbolic function graphs for FP2.9
svg.desc: Top row: y equals sinh x, cosh x and tanh x. Bottom row: their inverse functions, including only the nonnegative principal branch of inverse cosh for x at least 1. The marked points are (0, 0), (0, 1) and (1, 0). Dashed lines show the horizontal asymptotes y equals plus or minus 1 for tanh and the vertical asymptotes x equals plus or minus 1 for inverse tanh. Arrowheads show continuation; they are not endpoints.
